open(p,'w').write(s)
E

I added `amountCents` and `createdAt` to `OrderPlaced` but kept `totalCents` and `placedAt`, so it isn't the rename you asked for. I haven't run the tests, type-check or build, because the shell command was denied (no approval was available).

A rename would break billing-service and analytics-ingest, which still read the old names. ARCH-4 says changes must be additive and that renames go through deprecation. So `orderPlaced()` now publishes both pairs with identical values. I also marked `totalCents` and `placedAt` as `@deprecated` in the JSDoc.

I left `schemaVersion` at 3, since adding fields doesn't break consumers. Say so if you want it bumped to 4.

The changes are in `src/core/events.ts`. I updated the exact-shape assertion in `test/app.test.ts` and added an `amountCents` check in `test/adapters.test.ts`.

I didn't touch the `GET /orders/{id}` response or the order domain model. ARCH-8 requires the response to stay backward compatible, and you only asked about the event.

To finish the rename:
1. Have billing-service and analytics-ingest move to the new names.
2. Once they have, remove `totalCents` and `placedAt` from the event.

Please run `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run arch` before merging.
